Hi Anna  following up with the technical clarifications Marissa promised. Short answers up front, details after:  
- Telemetry vendors: by default we only send aggregated usage telemetry (metrics, anonymized traces). We do NOT forward raw user text or PII to third-party telemetry vendors in our standard configuration.
- Optional telemetry: customers can enable additional telemetry hooks for debug/diagnostics; these are off by default and require explicit opt-in and an associated DPA clause.
- Encryption / KMS: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for stored artifacts and log buckets in Dedicated and Private deployments. For Hosted, we offer a Bring-Your-Own-KMS (BYOK) path for enterprise customers  we can discuss specifics in the security call.
- Data residency: we support per-customer region pinning for logs and model input retention; for the Hosted plan we can pin to a US region for the POC.
- Marketplace flows: if you route through cloud marketplace (e.g., AWS Marketplace) note that the cloud provider is also listed as a subprocessor for billing/marketplace telemetry only  no access to customer inputs unless you enable a specific integration.

I attached a CSV inventory (subprocessors-inventory.csv) with vendor role and whether they receive logs, metrics, or PII. High-level: telemetry vendors = metrics only; cloud providers = infra/billing/log storage; telemetry/analytics vendors get no raw inputs by default.

If helpful, I can include contract language snippets for the DPA redline that explicitly prohibits forwarding user content to telemetry vendors.

Thanks,
Dev Patel
